description: Defines the TemplateBoolean class, a PHP class extending TemplateField, for rendering boolean fields in SuiteCRM. Contains methods for generating template variables for edit, search, detail, and list views.

classes.name: TemplateBoolean
classes.description: A PHP class for handling boolean field templates in SuiteCRM, providing methods for rendering different views.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Generates template variables for editing the boolean field, including help text and checked status.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Generates template variables for searching by the boolean field.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Generates template variables for displaying the boolean field in detail view.

methods.name: get_xtpl_list
methods.description: Returns the same output as get_xtpl_edit for list view.
